lead: Enabling a path leaves `#[expect(dead_code)]` on more functions than its doc lists, and clippy's `note:` names the one you already fixed.
body: The leftover sits on a helper of a helper, and `unfulfilled_lint_expectations` prints its reason, so the error appears to be about the function whose attribute was just removed. Run `grep -n 'expect(' <the module>` for every reason naming the path before the build.
